incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT INC-20260317-01 — Elevated 5xx and tail latency in eu-west serving lanes. Smart-routing shows economy-tier saturation and oscillation. Auto-mitigation attempted (reduced economy weight by 20%) — insufficient. Paging #eng-oncall and #incidents.
sam-oncall: I'm on it. Thanks. Linking runbook: https://go/runbooks/traffic-steer. Gathering metrics and affected customer list.
marta-sre: Observed: sustained 5xx on model shard euw-3; qps spike mostly from unauthenticated/free keys. KV cache miss rate x3 around the same time.
alex-runtime: We rolled "adaptive-economy-bias v2" ~18m ago. Recommend rolling that back if it's still active.
sam-oncall: Plan: 1) Disable adaptive-economy-bias globally. 2) Enforce temporary per-key qps cap on economy tier (5 rps). 3) Force-route heavy customers to priority lane in eu-west. Applying now.
sam-oncall: ```
# disable steering policy
infractl steering disable adaptive-economy-bias --regions=all --reason="INC-20260317-01"
# apply temporary caps
infractl quota set --tier=economy --qps=5 --duration=30m
# pin high-impact customers
infractl route pin --customer voyageranalytics --lane=priority-eu-west
```
ops-bot: Runbook action started by sam-oncall: infractl steering disable adaptive-economy-bias — in progress.
ops-bot: Action result: success — adaptive-economy-bias deactivated (commit ab12f3). Weight delta rolled back to baseline.
alex-runtime: Confirmed policy disabled. eu-west economy weight dropped from 0.15 -> 0.00.
marta-sre: Errors down ~40% in 3m; p50 latency improving. Still seeing elevated tail for a subset of customers (long-tail outliers).
csm-amy: FYI — VoyagerAnalytics filed a support ticket about degraded results in EU. They're on a dedicated plan but were routed to fallback due to spill. I opened CS-8891 and looped account team.
paul-product: Can we whitelist VoyagerAnalytics so our mitigation doesn't affect them further?
sam-oncall: Yes — just pinned them to priority lane. Applying now.
sam-oncall: ```
infractl route pin --customer voyageranalytics --lane=priority-eu-west --note="incident pin - INC-20260317-01"
``` 
ops-bot: Policy patch applied — voyageranalytics pinned to priority-eu-west.
jia-ml: Suggest enabling KV-prefetch/prewarm for model v3.2 serving in eu-west to reduce cache misses while we stabilize. Kicked off prewarm job.
marta-sre: Tail latencies are trending down after pins + caps + prewarm. We'll keep caps for 30m then reassess. Assigning postmortem owner: sam-oncall. ETA to stable: ~45m, monitoring.
sam-oncall: Mitigation summary (INC-20260317-01): disabled adaptive-economy-bias, enforced economy per-key cap=5 rps (30m), pinned 2 affected customers, started KV prewarm for model v3.2. No indicators of data loss or auth break. Customer-impact: ~7 mid-tier customers experienced degraded latency; 2 dedicated customers were briefly routed to fallback but now pinned. Next steps: traffic replay on staging to reproduce oscillation, rollback plan ready if we need to re-enable adaptive steering with safer thresholds.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Severity reduced to P2. Notifications sent to #support and #sales. Incident log: INC-20260317-01. Please add notes to the runbook.
marta-sre: Quick follow-ups: capture histograms for p99/p999, log KV miss correlation, validate per-customer token buckets. I'll add metrics links to the incident doc.
sam-oncall: 👍 will keep thread updated. If anyone sees regressions or new spikes, ping me directly. Closing active mitigation in 30m unless otherwise noted.
